result:
**Round 298 passes, but GATE297-F1 is only partly fixed. B must not mark it closed.**

I re-ran everything myself: the CLAIMS script, the file-scope checks, `npm run typecheck`, the 7 test files and the mutants (on my own scratch copy with its own Vite cache). I also ran the two browser rows in Playwright Chromium. Nine of the ten rows pass and none failed outright. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. App source was the same before and after my work.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| SOURCE-SCOPE | Only the 3 granted files changed. Each is byte-identical to B's version, and the protected and frozen files are unchanged. |
| TYPECHECK | Passes. |
| UNIT | 7 files, 58 tests pass. LH3 now runs from the new file. The slowest test (NG5) took 2.0 s of its 15 s limit. |
| UNIT-MUTANTS | (h) turns LH3 red. (e) turns LH1 and LH3 red. (g) turns LH4 red. (i) stays green, as expected. The control (mutant h against the old file) gives 4/4 green, which reproduces the original F1 bug. |
| UNIT-VACUITY | Removing the library reorder turns LH3 red. |
| UNIT-CLEANUP | Every hydrated root is unmounted after each test. Calling unmount twice does nothing the second time. |
| B-COLD-DEEPLINK | At 1440×900 and 1280×720, `?preview=middle-east` focuses and selects `demo-middle-east`, with 0 page errors and 0 hydration warnings. Plain `/studio-lab` leaves focus on the page body with the same selection. |
| G298-AUTH | A fresh, signed-out browser opens the demo with no `auth_user`. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no token. Premium auth is not bypassed. |
| DOC-220 | Status line, headings, file list and round numbers are as specified. |
| CLAIMS | **Not passed.** One of B's files, `b-round-297/sketch.patch`, is missing: the loop's `.gitignore` ignores `*.patch` files, so it was lost when the job moved machines. Everything else in the claims output matches. |

The first browser attempt timed out while the dev server was still compiling the protected route for the first time. I counted it as an environment failure and replaced it after a warm-up load.

Findings for B, recorded in `c-round-298.json`:
- **C-R298-01 (Medium).** LH3 still misses one kind of hydration mismatch. I added an attribute to the library option that exists only in the server HTML. React printed "Extra attributes from the server: data-probe", but all 4 tests stayed green: the narrowed warning pattern doesn't match that message. This confirms what A's reviewer found. An extra child element that exists only on the server *does* turn LH3 red, so the follow-up is a wider warning pattern plus a mutant that adds a server-only attribute. Doc 220 currently overstates what LH3 catches.
- **C-R298-02 (Low, B's planning).** The missing `sketch.patch`; this is the third time a cited artifact has gone missing. B could name such files `*.patch.txt`.
- **INFO-C298-01.** Every `/studio-lab` load aborts the request for `/middle-east.mp3`, though the server returns it fine (200). Probably not new: round 297 didn't record failed requests, and no app code changed this round.
- **INFO-C298-02.** Doc 220 still lists the old test count ("9 files, 89 tests"; this round's set is 7/58), and its sentence about cleanup after a failing test slightly overstates what the code does.

The full test suite, build, lint, `verify` and the e2e smoke test are root's gate rows; I did not run them.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-298.md
- c-round-298.json
- c-browse.json
- c-round-298/
